black_hole_mass.description: Measures the total gravitational mass of the black hole, expressed in solar masses (Msun).

eddington_ratio.description: Measures the ratio of an object's observed luminosity to its theoretical Eddington limit, which is a dimensionless quantity with no physical units.

radio_flux_6cm.description: Measures the spectral flux density of radio emissions at a 6-centimeter wavelength, reported in Janskys (Jy).
